metadata.title: fix: Export virtual server URLs now respect APP_ROOT_PATH configuration
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
Fixed issue where exported virtual server configuration URLs were not including the configured APP_ROOT_PATH prefix. This caused SSE, WebSocket, and JSON-RPC endpoint URLs to be incorrect when the gateway is deployed behind a reverse proxy with a custom root path.

Changes:
- Updated export_configuration endpoints in admin.py and main.py to use settings.app_root_path instead of request.scope root_path
- Added root_path parameter to export_selective method and _export_selected_servers method in export_service.py
- Both full and selective export now correctly include APP_ROOT_PATH in generated server endpoint URLs

Example:
- Before: https://<HOSTNAME>/servers/<SERVER_ID>/sse
- After: https://<HOSTNAME>/<APP_ROOT_PATH>/servers/<SERVER_ID>/sse

Closes #1319
